test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A policeman follows a thief who is 600 m ahead of the policeman. If the policeman and the thief run at speeds of 10 km/h and 8 km/h, respectively, in how much time (in minutes), will the policeman catch the thief?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between policeman and thief = 600 m

Speed of policeman = 10 km/h

Speed of thief = 8 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = relative speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance = relative speed × time

⇒ 600 = (10 - 8) × (5/18) × time

⇒ Time = (600 × 18)/(2 × 5)

⇒ Time = (60 × 18) = 1080 sec

⇒ Time = 1080 sec. = 1080/60 = 18 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 18 minutes.**
